_readme: Machine-readable index of image-reply styles for x-reply-guy. This file is CANONICAL for style-selection metadata; image-reply-styles.md is the human overview (hard rules + workflow rationale). The drafting step loads this file, matches the tweet against each style's category + when_to_use signals, fills the prompt_skeleton slots with tweet-specific content, and queues generation with the style's exemplar file as reference image.

generator.driver: node x-reply-guy/generate_reply_images.js — builds the items list from queued image replies (replies_to_post.json), runs the engine below, and records image_path back into the queue. Use this, not the engine directly.
generator.items_format: [{ image_id, slug, prompt, ref }] where ref = absolute path to this style's exemplar in x-reply-guy/example-images/
never: gpt_image_2 via Higgsfield CLI (ChatGPT images go through the browser pipeline only)
two ChatGPT automations at once: the chatgpt-profile Chrome is single-user; a second launch kills the first mid-generation

hard_rules: No numbers from the image model: no prices, market caps, dates-with-figures, or labeled chart values. Symbolic candles/arrows are fine. Real numbers go in the reply text.
In-image text stays short: one headline + a handful of 2-4 word labels. Proofread every generated word before queueing; a misspelled image is worse than no image.
Every image is unique: generated fresh for the specific tweet, never reused.
Persona rules apply to in-image text and reply text: no em dashes, TAO not tau, word-choice rules in persona/persona.json.
An image reply usually needs little or no text; the image IS the take. Don't restate the image in words.
Image replies are seasoning, not the default. Same spirit as the GIF quota: reserve for tweets where an image lands harder than words.
style_reference_note: Exemplar files are STYLE references only: the generator sends them so ChatGPT copies the look (medium, composition, texture), never the content. Image content comes 100% from the tweet-tailored prompt — never inherit an exemplar's Kaspa/teal theming into an unrelated tweet's image. needs_logo_ref only matters when the reply's take is actually about Kaspa.
kaspa_logo_note: The Kaspa logo K is a BACKWARDS (mirrored) capital K — exemplar renders showing a flipped K are CORRECT (persona.json image_generation.kaspa_coin is canonical). For styles that bake the logo in (needs_logo_ref: true), spell it out in the prompt in WORDS: 'the Kaspa logo: a backwards-K (mirrored capital K), glowing greenish-cyan teal'. Do NOT attach a standalone logo image as a second reference for scene images — persona.json warns the model can reproduce the coin full-frame and discard the scene; reserve schedule-tweets/images/reference/kaspa-logo.png for single-coin spotlight images only.

categories.hype: Tweet is bullish news, a milestone, a pump, or conviction energy. Amplify it.
categories.vindication: Tweet proves an old call right, a skeptic capitulates, or invites imagining the future being right.
categories.lineage: Tweet compares chains, eras, or generations. Succession narrative.
categories.explain: Tweet raises a concept worth diagramming. Calm parchment-sage lane, the signature look for smart replies.
categories.contrast: Tweet is FUD, a bad take, or a rivalry. Compare, weigh, expose, or mock.
categories.receipts: Tweet makes a claim we can dramatize as evidence or a verdict.
categories.identity: Community in-joke, holder identity, reaction-image energy.

styles.name: Bull-Ride Hype Poster
styles.when_to_use: Breakout day, big green candle, bull-market declaration, 'it's starting' energy.
styles.avoid_when: Neutral or technical tweets; red days.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Comic-book style poster, {SUBJECT} riding a charging teal bull up a glowing rising chart, neon trading-floor background, bold headline '{CAPTION}'

styles.name: Rocket Mission Patch
styles.when_to_use: Launch/listing/upgrade milestone, ATH push, 'destination' talk. Classier, subtler hype than the bull ride.
styles.avoid_when: Bad news, dips, anything non-celebratory.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Embroidered NASA-style space mission patch photographed on fabric, stitched border text '{MISSION NAME}' and '{MOTTO}', {CENTER ART} in the middle, realistic embroidery texture
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an embroidered NASA-style space mission patch, photographed on black fabric. Circular patch with stitched border text 'KASPA MISSION' at the top and 'DESTINATION: PRICE DISCOVERY' at the bottom, a rocket climbing past stars in the center with a teal circle bearing a white angular letter K on its fin. Realistic embroidery texture with visible stitching. Square format.

styles.name: Retro Propaganda Poster
styles.when_to_use: Red days, shakeouts, hold-the-line conviction rallying. Hype for when the market is DOWN.
styles.avoid_when: Green euphoria days (use bull ride or championship instead).
styles.prompt_skeleton: 1940s WPA propaganda poster style, heroic figure holding {OBJECT} aloft, bold flat colors with screen-print grain, slogan '{SLOGAN}', smaller line '{SUBLINE}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a 1940s WPA propaganda poster in bold flat colors with heavy screen-print grain. A heroic worker with rolled-up sleeves holds a glowing teal coin aloft like a torch, sunrays behind him. Bold slogan at the top: 'HOLD THE LINE'. Smaller text at the bottom: 'PROOF OF WORK PAYS'. Limited palette of teal, cream, charcoal and red. Portrait format.

styles.name: Blockbuster Movie Poster
styles.when_to_use: Anticipation of a big event/upgrade/announcement; dramatic narrative moments; 'something big is coming'.
styles.avoid_when: Small news; the format oversells minor updates.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Epic movie poster, {SUBJECT} as the hero, title '{TITLE}', tagline '{TAGLINE}', tiny blurred billing block at the bottom, dramatic cinematic lighting
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an epic Hollywood movie poster. A lone figure stands on a cliff at dawn facing a colossal glowing teal coin rising like a sun over a distant city skyline. Big metallic title across the middle: 'THE SETTLEMENT'. Tagline at the top: 'SOME REVOLUTIONS ARRIVE IN SECONDS'. A tiny blurred billing block at the bottom like a real one-sheet. Dramatic cinematic lighting. Portrait format.

styles.name: Championship Celebration
styles.when_to_use: A confirmed WIN: flippening moment, milestone achieved, target hit, race won.
styles.avoid_when: Unconfirmed hopes; premature celebration reads badly later.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Sports championship celebration in glossy 3D cartoon style, team in {COLOR} jerseys lifting a giant trophy shaped like {OBJECT}, confetti, stadium lights, jersey text '{JERSEY WORD}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a sports championship celebration in glossy 3D cartoon style. A team in teal jerseys lifts a giant golden trophy shaped like a coin engraved with the letter K, confetti raining, stadium lights blazing, roaring crowd behind. One jersey back reads 'HODL'. Square format.

styles.name: Weather Forecast
styles.when_to_use: Market-wide green days, altseason talk, anyone making predictions/forecasts (playful reply).
styles.avoid_when: Serious analysis threads where a gag undercuts the point.
styles.prompt_skeleton: TV weather forecast scene in polished 3D cartoon style, meteorologist pointing at a map covered in {MAP ICONS}, lower-third banner '{FORECAST LINE}', broadcast graphics look
styles.notes: Exemplar added unprompted city temperature numbers; harmless weather-gag numbers, but production prompts can add 'no temperature numbers' if wanted.
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a TV weather forecast scene in polished 3D cartoon style. A cheerful meteorologist in a suit points at a big weather map covered in glowing green candlestick icons and upward arrows instead of clouds. Lower-third broadcast banner reads: 'FORECAST: GREEN CANDLES ALL WEEK'. Studio lighting, news-broadcast graphics look. Landscape format.

styles.name: Future Storefront Skit
styles.when_to_use: Imagine-the-future takes, adoption speculation, price-target talk. Puts the viewer inside the future moment.
styles.avoid_when: Backward-looking tweets; this format is forward-looking.
styles.prompt_skeleton: 3D cartoon scene, {EVERYDAY PLACE} in the future where {THING} is normal, characters with speech bubbles '{LINE1}' '{LINE2}', signage doing the storytelling

styles.name: Front Page from the Future
styles.when_to_use: News that will look historic in hindsight; 'remember this day' moments; adoption breakthroughs.
styles.avoid_when: Rumors; a fake front page about an unconfirmed claim reads as misinformation.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Vintage newspaper front page, masthead 'THE DAILY LEDGER', giant headline '{HEADLINE}', subheadline '{SUBHEAD}', black and white halftone photo of {SCENE}, no visible dates or numbers
styles.notes: Model renders surprisingly coherent body copy (with em dashes, acceptable inside newspaper body text only). Keep headline + subhead as the controlled text.
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a vintage newspaper front page with aged newsprint texture. Masthead reads 'THE DAILY LEDGER'. Giant headline: 'KASPA SETTLES THE INTERNET'. Subheadline: 'Skeptics ask why they waited'. A black and white halftone photo of a crowd celebrating around a glowing teal coin statue in a city square. Classic newspaper column layout with no visible dates or numbers. Portrait format.

styles.name: Time Traveler
styles.when_to_use: Regret narratives, 'wish I bought earlier', missed-opportunity tweets, urgent conviction moments.
styles.avoid_when: Financial-advice-adjacent contexts; the joke is a warning, keep it clearly comedic.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Single dynamic comic-book panel, a time traveler in glowing gear bursting from a portal grabbing a startled person, speech bubble '{WARNING}', bold inking and halftone shading
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a single dynamic comic-book panel with bold inking and halftone shading. A frantic time traveler in a glowing futuristic suit bursts out of a swirling portal into a living room and grabs a startled man by the shoulders. Speech bubble from the traveler: 'WHATEVER YOU DO, DO NOT SELL'. Square format.

styles.name: Museum of Doubters
styles.when_to_use: A skeptic or bear capitulating, doubling down absurdly, or being proven wrong by events.
styles.avoid_when: Punching down at small accounts; aim it at narratives, not people.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Natural history museum exhibit, {FIGURE} displayed behind glass in a lifelike diorama, brass plaque reading '{PLAQUE}' with smaller line '{SUBPLAQUE}', warm museum lighting, visitor silhouettes
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a natural history museum exhibit scene. Behind glass, a lifelike waxwork of a grumpy man in a suit frozen mid-shrug at a desk with an old computer showing a red downward line. A brass plaque on the display reads: 'THE LAST BEAR'. Below it in smaller engraving: 'He was still waiting for a dip'. Warm museum lighting, silhouettes of visitors in the foreground. Landscape format.

styles.name: Three-Panel Torch Pass
styles.when_to_use: BTC vs ETH vs KAS comparisons, 'next big thing' threads, evolution-of-crypto takes.
styles.avoid_when: Tweets hostile to the succession framing (BTC maxis); it invites a fight.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Three-panel comic poster, {A} then {B} then {C} as armored coin-headed heroes passing a torch left to right, 3-4 word feature labels per panel, bottom verdict strip '{VERDICT}'

styles.name: Evolution March
styles.when_to_use: Progress-of-money takes, old-vs-new tech, 'we've come a long way' framing. Cleaner and calmer than the torch pass.
styles.avoid_when: When the tweet isn't about progression.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Evolution-of-man silhouette progression on a clean gradient, {N} stages from hunched to upright, each carrying {OBJECTS}, final figure holding {FINAL OBJECT} overhead, labels '{LABELS}', minimalist infographic style
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create the classic evolution-of-man silhouette progression against a clean gradient background, minimalist infographic style. Four walking silhouettes evolve left to right: a hunched figure dragging a huge heavy coin, then two progressively more upright figures carrying smaller sleeker coins, ending in a confident fully upright figure holding a small glowing teal coin overhead. Labels under the four stages: 'GOLD', 'BITCOIN', 'ETHEREUM', 'KASPA'. Landscape format.

styles.name: Podium Ceremony
styles.when_to_use: Rankings, performance comparisons, flippening talk, 'who wins the cycle' debates.
styles.avoid_when: When the claimed ranking isn't defensible; it's a strong visual claim.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Olympic podium ceremony in glossy 3D cartoon style, {WINNER} coin mascot triumphant on the top step, {SECOND} and {THIRD} coin mascots on the lower steps with fitting expressions, stadium crowd
styles.notes: Exemplar has minor background garbles (banner text, medal glyphs); acceptable at feed size, but check backgrounds on production gens.
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an Olympic medal podium ceremony in glossy 3D cartoon style. Three coin mascots with arms and legs stand on the podium: on the tall center step a teal coin with a white letter K raises its arms in triumph, an orange coin with a letter B stands on the second step clapping politely, and a purple coin with a diamond symbol sulks on the third step. Stadium crowd and camera flashes behind. Square format.

styles.name: Parchment Vault
styles.when_to_use: Security/trust/custody concepts; 'what makes X safe'; one central metaphor with proof-badges around it.
styles.avoid_when: Multi-part concepts (use quadrant or hub-and-spoke).
styles.prompt_skeleton: Hand-inked illustration on aged parchment, {CENTRAL METAPHOR} in the middle, wax seal stamps labeled {BADGES}, headline '{TITLE}', checkmark scroll below

styles.name: Quadrant Playbook
styles.when_to_use: Frameworks, '4 kinds of X', pick-the-right-tool takes, decision-making threads.
styles.avoid_when: Concepts that don't split into 3-4 clean parts.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Aged parchment 2x2 quadrant diagram, four hand-inked vignettes labeled {L1} {L2} {L3} {L4}, headline '{TITLE}', subtitle '{SUBTITLE}'

styles.name: Hub-and-Spoke
styles.when_to_use: Ecosystem/architecture/coordination concepts; one thing orchestrating many.
styles.avoid_when: Linear processes (blueprint or metro map fit better).
styles.prompt_skeleton: Parchment diagram, central {HUB} radiating orange arrows to {N} nodes labeled {LABEL}, special corner element {CORNER} with wax seal reading '{SEAL}'

styles.name: Da Vinci Anatomy
styles.when_to_use: Archetype breakdowns: 'the X community', what makes a holder/builder/maxi tick. Affectionate, not mocking.
styles.avoid_when: Text-heavy concepts; this format needs many short labels, watch garbling.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Da Vinci style anatomical study on parchment, '{TITLE}', figure of {ARCHETYPE} with labeled parts: {PART LABELS}, dashed annotation arrows, torch-lit margins

styles.name: Iceberg Cutaway
styles.when_to_use: Surface-vs-substance takes: price obsession vs fundamentals, 'what people don't see'.
styles.avoid_when: Tweets already about the hidden depth; the reveal is the whole joke.
styles.prompt_skeleton: In the hand-inked aged parchment style of the reference, cross-section of an iceberg, small tip above water labeled '{SURFACE}', massive underwater body with layer labels {DEPTH LABELS}, engraved headline '{TITLE}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: In the exact hand-inked aged parchment illustration style of the reference image, create a cross-section diagram of an iceberg floating in dark water. Above the waterline is a small tip labeled 'THE PRICE'. Below the waterline a massive submerged body with layer labels: 'THE TECH', 'THE MINERS', 'THE COMMUNITY', 'THE VISION'. Headline at the top in engraved serif type: 'WHAT THE MARKET SEES'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.when_to_use: How-it-works engineering takes, tech-spec discussions, 'this is a machine that works' framing.
styles.avoid_when: Emotional/narrative tweets; blueprint is cold by design.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Engineering blueprint, white technical line drawing of {SYSTEM} on blueprint-blue paper with faint grid, annotation callouts {LABELS}, title block reading '{TITLE}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an engineering blueprint: crisp white technical line drawing on deep blueprint-blue paper with a faint grid. The drawing shows a machine made of interconnected blocks feeding into a spinning turbine, with short annotation callouts: 'PARALLEL BLOCKS', 'INSTANT SETTLEMENT', 'PROOF OF WORK'. A title block in the bottom right corner reads 'PROJECT: SOUND MONEY'. Landscape format.

styles.name: Metro Map
styles.when_to_use: Ecosystems or narratives with many parts converging on one destination; roadmap-ish takes without dates.
styles.avoid_when: Single-concept tweets; the map needs multiple lines to shine.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Minimalist metro transit map on off-white, {N} colored lines with small station dots named {STATIONS}, converging at highlighted interchange '{HUB}', legend box naming the lines {LINE NAMES}
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a minimalist metro transit map on an off-white background with classic transit-map typography and rounded line corners. Three colored lines in teal, orange and purple run across the map with small station dots, converging at one large highlighted interchange station labeled 'SELF CUSTODY'. A clean legend box names the lines: 'SPEED LINE', 'SECURITY LINE', 'SCARCITY LINE'. Landscape format.

styles.name: Bayeux Tapestry
styles.when_to_use: Retelling a market saga (crash, shakeout, recovery) as mock-ancient history; gallows humor after volatility.
styles.avoid_when: Live ongoing events; works best once the dust settles.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Bayeux tapestry style embroidery on aged linen, stitched panels showing {EVENT SEQUENCE}, stitched caption '{CAPTION}' in medieval lettering, embroidered border of {BORDER MOTIFS}
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a medieval Bayeux tapestry style embroidery on aged linen, one long horizontal panel. Stitched scenes tell a saga from left to right: panicked medieval traders selling coins to a smug merchant, the merchant sailing away on a ship with a rising green thread-line stitched behind him, then the traders weeping on the shore. Stitched caption along the top in medieval lettering: 'PAPER HANDS SELLETH THE BOTTOM'. Embroidered border of small coins and diamonds. Landscape format.

styles.name: Two Lanes Split
styles.when_to_use: Congestion/fees/speed comparisons; legacy vs new; any clean A-vs-B where one side is obviously better.
styles.avoid_when: Nuanced comparisons; this format only does black-and-white.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Split image divided vertically, left side {BAD STATE} grey and gridlocked labeled '{L}', right side {GOOD STATE} vivid and flowing labeled '{R}', same camera angle both sides, clean 3D render
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a clean 3D-rendered image split vertically down the middle into two halves shot from the same camera angle. Left half: a grey congested ten-lane highway in total gridlock under smog, labeled at the top 'LEGACY RAILS'. Right half: a vivid open teal highway at dawn with a single car streaking along light trails, labeled at the top 'KASPA'. Square format.

styles.name: Balance Scale Etching
styles.when_to_use: Hype-vs-substance debates, narrative-vs-fundamentals, weighing claims. Elegant, understated.
styles.avoid_when: High-energy moments that want loud visuals.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Vintage copperplate etching, ornate balance scale with one pan heavy holding {HEAVY} and one pan floating holding {LIGHT}, labels on each, engraved caption '{CAPTION}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a vintage copperplate etching on cream paper with fine crosshatched engraving lines. A large ornate balance scale: one pan hangs heavy and low holding a dense stack of engraved stone blocks labeled 'PROOF', the other pan floats high holding puffs of hot air and megaphones labeled 'HYPE'. Small engraved caption beneath: 'THE MARKET WEIGHS ALL THINGS EVENTUALLY'. Square format.

styles.name: Fight Night Poster
styles.when_to_use: Direct FUD to counter head-on; X-vs-Y beef threads; tale-of-the-tape comparisons in words.
styles.avoid_when: When engaging elevates a bad-faith account; don't give FUD a stage it didn't earn.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Boxing fight-night poster, {A} vs {B} facing off under arena spotlights, headline '{EVENT}', tale-of-the-tape rows in short words {TAPE ROWS}, gritty poster texture
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a gritty boxing fight-night poster. Two muscular fighters face off under dramatic arena spotlights: on the left a shadowy hooded fighter in a dark robe stitched 'FUD', on the right a confident fighter in teal trunks with a K emblem labeled 'FUNDAMENTALS'. Big metallic headline at the top: 'THE MAIN EVENT'. Between the fighters a tale-of-the-tape list in short words: 'RUMORS vs CODE', 'NOISE vs HASHRATE', 'FEAR vs CONVICTION'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Report Card
styles.when_to_use: Chain outages, broken promises, failed roadmaps; grading a competitor's track record.
styles.avoid_when: Grading real named projects too harshly invites drama; keep targets generic ('centralized chains').
styles.prompt_skeleton: Old-school paper report card on a wooden desk photographed from above, letterhead '{SCHOOL}', student name '{STUDENT}', graded rows with red ink letter grades {ROWS}, handwritten red teacher note '{COMMENT}', rubber stamp '{STAMP}'
styles.notes: Exemplar added an unprompted date (05/21/2025) and signed 'S. Nakamoto'. The signature is a keeper; the date shows the model adds figures on its own. QA every production gen for stray dates/numbers.
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a realistic old-school paper report card lying on a wooden school desk, photographed from above at a slight angle. Letterhead reads 'CRYPTO ACADEMY: TERM REPORT'. Student name line reads 'CENTRALIZED CHAINS'. A graded subject table with red ink letter grades: 'Decentralization: F', 'Uptime: D', 'Promises kept: F', 'Marketing: A'. A handwritten red teacher note at the bottom: 'See me after class.' A square red rubber stamp reads 'MUST REPEAT YEAR'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Airport X-Ray
styles.when_to_use: Exposing what's really inside a project or narrative: decentralization theater, hidden custodians, VC coins.
styles.avoid_when: Unverifiable accusations about named projects; keep the suitcase generic.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Airport security scene in polished 3D cartoon style, suitcase covered in stickers reading {STICKERS} entering an x-ray scanner, monitor revealing {CONTENTS} inside, shocked guard pointing
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an airport security scene in polished 3D cartoon style. A conveyor belt feeds a sleek expensive suitcase covered in glossy stickers reading 'TRUST US' and 'TOTALLY DECENTRALIZED' into an x-ray scanner. The scanner monitor shows the suitcase interior in glowing x-ray view: a single large bank building attached to puppet strings. A shocked security guard points at the screen. Landscape format.

styles.name: Detective Evidence Board
styles.when_to_use: Connect-the-dots bullish cases: accumulation signals, on-chain trends, multiple developments pointing one way.
styles.avoid_when: Single-fact tweets; the board needs 3+ clues to work.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Detective evidence corkboard in moody noir lighting, pinned polaroids and notes labeled {CLUES} connected by red string converging on a center card reading '{CONCLUSION}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a detective's evidence corkboard photographed straight on in moody noir lighting. Pinned polaroids and torn notes connected by red string: a photo of glowing server racks labeled 'HASHRATE RISING', a photo of a hardware wallet labeled 'SUPPLY LEAVING EXCHANGES', a handwritten note reading 'DEVS KEEP SHIPPING', and a torn map fragment. All strings converge on one center index card that reads 'IT WAS NEVER DEAD'. Landscape format.

styles.name: Courtroom Sketch
styles.when_to_use: FUD debunked by facts or results; a narrative on trial and losing.
styles.avoid_when: Actual legal news; too easy to misread as commentary on a real case.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Pastel courtroom-artist sketch with loose strokes, {DEFENDANT} on the witness stand looking nervous, judge holding up {EVIDENCE}, jury watching, hand-lettered caption '{CAPTION}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a pastel courtroom-artist sketch on textured paper with loose expressive strokes. On the witness stand sits a sweating cartoon ghost labeled 'FUD', shrinking under questioning. A stern judge peers over glasses while holding up a glowing green upward chart as evidence. A jury of skeptical citizens watches. Hand-lettered caption along the bottom edge: 'THE EVIDENCE DID NOT COOPERATE'. Landscape format.

styles.name: Tarot Card
styles.when_to_use: Holder identity, destiny/conviction vibes, 'this is the way' moments; works as a flex or a blessing.
styles.avoid_when: Hard-news contexts; too mystical for factual threads.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Ornate tarot card in Rider-Waite style, allegorical figure of {ARCHETYPE} in {SCENE}, decorative art-nouveau border, Roman numeral at top, banner reading '{NAME}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an ornate tarot card in classic Rider-Waite style with rich gold and teal inks and a decorative art-nouveau border. The card shows a serene robed figure standing on a mountain of coins, holding one glowing teal coin up to the sky while storms and red lightning rage harmlessly around him. Small suns and diamonds in the corners, the Roman numeral XXI at the top. Banner at the bottom reads 'THE HOLDER'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Creature Trading Card
styles.when_to_use: Community personas, diamond-hands jokes, playful self-description of holder behavior.
styles.avoid_when: Serious market commentary.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Collectible creature trading card with holographic foil border, art window showing {CREATURE}, name bar '{NAME}', ability lines {ABILITIES} in the text box, glossy texture, slight 3D tilt
styles.notes: Exemplar added unprompted joke stats (HP 420, WEIGHT: infinity, 21/21 LIMITED EDITION) plus flavor text. Meme numbers are acceptable here since they read as card-game stats, not market data; still QA that nothing resembles a real figure.
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a collectible creature trading card with a holographic foil border and glossy texture, shown at a slight 3D tilt. The art window shows a chubby powerful teal dragon curled protectively around a pile of glowing coins, refusing to let go. Name bar reads 'DIAMOND CLAW'. Ability lines in the text box: 'IRON GRIP: cannot be shaken out' and 'HODL AURA: grows stronger every dip'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Wanted Poster
styles.when_to_use: Paper-hands mockery, bottom-seller moments, capitulation days (aimed at behavior, not a person).
styles.avoid_when: Naming or depicting a real account; the outlaw is always an archetype.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Old west wanted poster on weathered torn parchment, halftone portrait of {FIGURE}, big slab type 'WANTED', name line '{NAME}', crime line '{CRIME}', bullet holes and sun-bleached texture
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create an old west wanted poster on weathered torn parchment nailed to a wooden wall, sun-bleached with bullet holes. Halftone portrait of a shifty nervous cowboy clutching an empty money bag. Big western slab type: 'WANTED' at the top. Beneath the portrait: 'THE BOTTOM SELLER'. Crime line in smaller type: 'SOLD EVERYTHING ONE DAY BEFORE THE RUN'. Portrait format.

styles.name: Nature Documentary Still
styles.when_to_use: Calm-holder-amid-panic moments, volatility days, 'stay patient' energy. Deadpan Attenborough register.
styles.avoid_when: Genuinely bad news for holders; calm reads as cope.
styles.prompt_skeleton: Cinematic nature-documentary still, letterboxed, {CREATURE} calm in its habitat while {CHAOS} rages behind, documentary subtitle caption '{NARRATION}'
styles.exemplar_prompt: Create a cinematic nature-documentary film still, letterboxed with black bars top and bottom. In golden savanna light a majestic lion sits utterly calm on a rock while a chaotic blurred stampede of panicked wildebeest rushes past in the background. Documentary subtitle caption in clean white type at the bottom: 'The patient holder ignores the stampede. He has seen many winters.' Landscape format.
